== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A cutlass is a type of [[sword]] used by [[Calder]], appearing similar in shape to the dueling sabers he practiced with during his childhood. While some versions are described as mundane metal, [[Calder]] possesses an [[Awakened cutlass]] that is unique and powerful. This specific weapon features a long, black blade marked with irregular orange spots that resemble the shifting patterns of hot coals. This Awakened blade can be infused with [[Intent]] to provide a combat advantage against certain enemies, such as the living dead. A highly significant and ancient cutlass exists that predates [[The Empire|the Empire]] and its Emperor, potentially sharing an age with a great monster. This unique weapon has been used by generations of [[Consultants]] and assassins over a thousand years, harvesting many important lives. It is characterized by its immense power, capable of breaking any defense, stealing any power, and taking any life. The blade carries a palpable weight of [[Intent]] from its many kills and possesses a magnetic quality that guides it back into its sheath.}}
